description: Real-valued numerical optimization for rank-22 decomposition of T333

als_rank23_best_random.note: rank-23 known to exist but ALS from random also does NOT converge

interpretation.main_finding: LM from cn122 truncation achieves 2.23e-4 residual and is still decreasing at 10000 nfev, but the rate is sublinear. Cannot determine if limit is 0 (rank 22 exists) or positive (local minimum).
interpretation.calibration: Rank-23 from random starts also fails to converge with ALS (best 8.8e-3), so non-convergence at rank 22 is not evidence for rank > 22. T333 has extremely non-convex loss surface.
interpretation.missing_comparison: Rank-23 comparison with LM and control tensor comparison did not complete due to timeout.

convergence_trajectory.interpretation: Factor 2.45 improvement with 5x more evaluations -> sublinear convergence
